_comment: Units: metres / radians, CoppeliaSim world frame. Robot names must match aliases in the scene (Robot_0 is cloned for missing ones). CLI flags --num-robots / --start / --goal override this file.

auto_start_area._comment: Used for robots without an explicit start (e.g. when num_robots > robots listed).

goals._comment_: Only used when goals_mode is 'goals' (or when --goal is passed). Values: station name or [x, y].
